description: Angular component for managing value source settings in a widget, including form handling, entity alias and key filtering, and validation logic.

classes.name: ValueSourceComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and configuring a value source, supporting predefined values or entity attributes, with form validation and filtering.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form, sets up value change subscriptions, and loads entity aliases.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided value and updates validators.

methods.name: clearEntityAlias
methods.description: Clears the entity alias input and refocuses.

methods.name: clearKey
methods.description: Clears the attribute key input and refocuses.

methods.name: fetchEntityAliases
methods.description: Filters and returns entity aliases based on search text.

methods.name: fetchKeys
methods.description: Filters and returns entity keys based on search text.

methods.name: fetchEntityKeys
methods.description: Retrieves entity keys from the entity service.

methods.name: createKeyFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for keys starting with the query.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates changes.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on value source type.
